label: quality management system
definition: A documented system ensuring compliance with the Regulation, including strategies for regulatory compliance, design controls, data management, risk management, post-market monitoring, incident reporting, and accountability frameworks.
source_quote: Providers of high-risk AI systems shall put a quality management system in place that ensures compliance with this Regulation

label: strategy for regulatory compliance
definition: A component of the quality management system covering compliance with conformity assessment procedures and modification management.
source_quote: a strategy for regulatory compliance, including compliance with conformity assessment procedures and procedures for the management of modifications to the high-risk AI system

label: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification
definition: Systematic actions applied during the design, design control, and design verification phases of a high-risk AI system.
source_quote: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the design, design control and design verification of the high-risk AI system

label: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance
definition: Systematic actions applied during the development, quality control, and quality assurance phases of a high-risk AI system.
source_quote: techniques, procedures and systematic actions to be used for the development, quality control and quality assurance of the high-risk AI system

label: examination, test and validation procedures
definition: Procedures carried out before, during, and after development to verify the high-risk AI system, including defined frequencies.
source_quote: examination, test and validation procedures to be carried out before, during and after the development of the high-risk AI system

label: technical specifications, including standards
definition: Standards and means to ensure compliance with relevant requirements set out in Section 2 when harmonised standards are not fully applied.
source_quote: technical specifications, including standards, to be applied and, where the relevant harmonised standards are not applied in full or do not cover all of the relevant requirements set out in Section 2, the means to be used to ensure that the high-risk AI system complies with those requirements

label: systems and procedures for data management
definition: Systems covering data acquisition, collection, analysis, labelling, storage, filtration, mining, aggregation, retention, and other operations related to data used in high-risk AI systems.
source_quote: systems and procedures for data management, including data acquisition, data collection, data analysis, data labelling, data storage, data filtration, data mining, data aggregation, data retention and any other operation regarding the data that is performed before and for the purpose of the placing on the market or the putting into service of high-risk AI systems

label: the risk management system referred to in Article 9
definition: The risk management system required under Article 9, included as an aspect of the quality management system.
source_quote: the risk management system referred to in Article 9

label: post-market monitoring system
definition: A system for setting up, implementing, and maintaining post-market monitoring in accordance with Article 72.
source_quote: the setting-up, implementation and maintenance of a post-market monitoring system, in accordance with Article 72

label: procedures related to the reporting of a serious incident
definition: Procedures for reporting serious incidents in accordance with Article 73.
source_quote: procedures related to the reporting of a serious incident in accordance with Article 73

label: handling of communication with national competent authorities
definition: Procedures for managing communications with national competent authorities, other relevant authorities, notified bodies, operators, customers, and interested parties.
source_quote: the handling of communication with national competent authorities, other relevant authorities, including those providing or supporting the access to data, notified bodies, other operators, customers or other interested parties

label: systems and procedures for record-keeping
definition: Systems and procedures for keeping all relevant documentation and information.
source_quote: systems and procedures for record-keeping of all relevant documentation and information

label: resource management, including security-of-supply related measures
definition: Management of resources including measures related to security of supply.
source_quote: resource management, including security-of-supply related measures

label: accountability framework
definition: A framework setting out the responsibilities of management and other staff regarding all aspects listed in Article 17(1).
source_quote: an accountability framework setting out the responsibilities of the management and other staff with regard to all the aspects listed in this paragraph
